answers.how: The antelope moves about 313 px in 2.467 s, giving a scale of 0.0101 m/px. Its average nose-to-tail extent is about 296 px.
Near 1 s, the rabbit moves approximately 120 px/s. Applying the antelope-derived scale of 0.0101 m/px gives 1.21 m/s.
The rabbit is approximately 41 px long. Multiplying by the antelope-derived scale of 0.0101 m/px gives 0.41 m.
